title: The document family has no source file, so no version, section, ID or date can be carried forward
source: 09 Testing and quality folder listing of 22 November 2026
description: The work package names the Recovery Workbench Integration Test Plan as an output but the folder holds no file of this family in any version, and no other folder of the document set holds one. A plan written against a missing source keeps no section, identifier, number or date, and its version sequence starts at 1.
evidence: Folder 09 Testing and quality holds the Test Strategy, Non Functional Test Plan, Test Data Plan, Definition of Ready and Done, Defect Management Process, User Acceptance Test Plan, Test Cases, Regression Suite and Requirements Traceability Matrix, and no Integration Test Plan in any version; a recursive search for a file name containing Integration Test returns no result.
proposed: Issue version 1 with date 22 November 2026, a Supersedes row reading None (first version), and a change-log row that states the family is new; no predecessor section, ID, number or date is cited.

title: No source states an integration-level exit threshold
source: 09 Testing and quality/Recovery Workbench Test Strategy v3.docx
description: The test strategy fixes the exit of the SIT, UAT and Release gates and of the four wave gates as every journey of the wave passing with no open severity 1 or 2 defect. It states no pass rate, no percentage and no defect density for the integration level, and no other source read for this plan supplies one.
evidence: Test strategy version 3 section 3 exit column: 'Every wave 1 journey passes; no open severity 1 or 2'; section 7: 'A release goes with no open severity 1 or 2 defect'. No integration pass rate appears in the test strategy, the non-functional test plan version 3, Template and Rules section R5 or the ITG stories.
proposed: Adopt the SIT exit wording of the test strategy version 3 for every wave gate and invent no pass rate; a gate closes on every journey test case passing with no open severity 1 or 2 defect.

title: The number and calendar of integration test cycles per wave are not stated
source: 09 Testing and quality/Recovery Workbench Test Strategy v3.docx
description: A wave gate is defined by its entry and its exit and by no date. No source read for this plan states how many integration cycles a wave runs, how long a cycle takes or when it starts relative to the wave release date, so the plan cannot state a test window.
evidence: Test strategy version 3 section 3 gives the wave gates entry and exit conditions only; Template and Rules section R5.6 gives a wave per business epic and no calendar; the ITG journey stories name a business date as test data and no test window.
proposed: Fix one integration test cycle per wave that closes the wave gate before the first release date of the wave, assert no window beyond that, and keep every release date unchanged and tentative.

title: The seed, business date, volumes and identifiers of the synthetic fixture set are not stated
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-ITG-W1 Wave 1 integration/RWB ITG W1J01 ITG Contract-test harness and synthetic test data - integration v1.md
description: The harness story requires a deterministic set generated from a seed and a business date and names the eleven fixture classes, and it leaves the seed, the business date, the volumes and the identifiers to configuration. No source read for this plan gives those values, so the plan cannot state how many accounts, cases, documents or templates the set holds.
evidence: RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG section 3: 'The seed, the business date and the identifiers of the synthetic set are Not specified in the source documents'; section 11: 'The composition, the volumes and the identifiers of the set are Not specified in the source documents'.
proposed: Keep the seed, the business date, the volumes and the identifiers as configuration of RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG, following the fixture classes the wave stories name, and write the Template and Rules R9 placeholder until the QA lead sets them.

title: The pack, the evidence format and the retention of a journey and harness run are not stated
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-ITG-W1 Wave 1 integration/RWB ITG W1J02 ITG Wave 1 v5 journey end to end - integration v1.md
section: 13. Test case inventory and 14. Defects, evidence and reporting
description: Each journey states that the full test with its Given, When and Then is held in its harness pack and that the pack, the environment and the evidence format are not specified. No source read for this plan states the report schema, where the evidence is stored or how long it is kept, so the plan can state what the evidence proves but not its form or its life.
evidence: RWB-ITG-W1J02-ITG section 16: 'its pack, environment and evidence format are Not specified in the source documents'; RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG section 16: 'its pack contents and its evidence retention are Not specified in the source documents'; section 12.8: 'The stub set's location and its publication channel are Not specified in the source documents'.
proposed: Keep the evidence with the build it proves and past the gate that reads it, keyed by build for the harness and by story and business date for a journey; assert no retention period until the QA lead sets one.

title: How SIT is composed while a later-wave service is not deployed is not stated
source: 09 Testing and quality/Recovery Workbench Test Strategy v3.docx
description: The target arrives in four waves, so a wave run in SIT meets services that exist and services that do not. The test strategy says the statement of how SIT is composed across waves is not in any source, and no other source read for this plan fills the gap, so the plan cannot say whether a later-wave contract is faked, stubbed or omitted in a wave journey.
evidence: Test strategy version 3 section 2: 'the statement of how SIT is composed across waves is not in any source read for this document'; Template and Rules section R5.4 allows a C dependency to be built against a published contract and its fake, and says nothing about the composition of a shared environment.
proposed: Serve every contract of a service that is not yet deployed by its published fake, name every stubbed hop in the journey report, and never count a stubbed hop as a real-owner pass.

title: Which non-functional requirements are proven at the integration level is not stated
source: 03 Requirements and specifications/Recovery Workbench Non Functional Specification v3.md
description: The non-functional specification gives 78 requirements with a target and a test method each, and the non-functional test plan version 3 schedules them per service, per journey and per platform area. Neither states which identifiers a wave gate reads as integration evidence and which stay at the system level, so a reader of this plan cannot tell how far the integration gate reaches.
evidence: Non-functional specification v3 requirement rows carry an ID, a target, an owner and a status and no test level; non-functional test plan version 3 sections 6 to 8 hold NFT-<service>-<nn>, NFT-J-<nn> and NFT-PLT-<nn> rows with a when column and no level.
proposed: Read the integration evidence as the two RWB-ITG-NFR stories, the NFT-J rows and the NFR level test cases of the wave journeys, and leave every other identifier to the per-service and system tests of the non-functional test plan.

title: No source states who signs a wave gate
source: 09 Testing and quality/Recovery Workbench Test Strategy v3.docx
description: The wave gates of the strategy state an exit as a set of passing tests and open defects, and name no signatory. The Release row of the same table names a release owner, and the ITG stories name a QA lead, an integration lead and a service owner in their authority tables; no source combines these into a gate signature.
evidence: Test strategy version 3 section 3 Release row: 'Go decision by the release owner'; the four wave gate rows name no role; RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG section 10 gives the QA lead the gate definition and the integration lead the contract pinning and names no signatory.
proposed: Record the wave gate as signed by the QA lead with the integration lead on the report of the harness and of the journey, and write roles only.

title: The harness is described as serving all four waves and scoped to the wave 1 services
source: 09 Testing and quality/Recovery Workbench Test Strategy v3.docx
description: The test strategy says the harness RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG is Day 1 and serves all four waves. The story itself checks the wave 1 contracts, publishes one stub per wave 1 service and names the wave 1 suites as its consumers, while the later waves carry a journey story and no harness story of their own. The two readings give a different scope to the same story.
evidence: Test strategy version 3 section 10: 'The harness RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG (contract-test harness and synthetic test data) is Day 1 and serves all four waves'; RWB-ITG-W1J01-ITG AC1 to AC7 and section 12.8 cover the nine wave 1 services and their stub set; the split plan holds W1J01 in epic RWB-ITG-W1 and no J01 harness story in W2, W3 or W4.
proposed: Read the story as the wave 1 increment of one harness that each later wave extends by pinning its contracts and generating one stub per service of that wave.

title: The wave 3 journey drives rwb-partner, which the wave map places in wave 4
source: 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-ITG-W3 Wave 3 integration/RWB ITG W3J01 ITG Wave 3 journey end to end - integration v1.md
description: The wave 3 journey names rwb-partner among the services it drives at its last hop, the instruction to the firm. The Ownership Map and Template and Rules place S9 rwb-partner in wave 4, so the hop meets a service that does not exist in wave 3 and the plan cannot treat it as a real-owner hop.
evidence: RWB-ITG-W3J01-ITG section 1 names 'rwb-guarantee, rwb-comms, rwb-litigation and rwb-partner'; Ownership Map v1 sheet Services gives S9 rwb-partner Wave 4; Template and Rules section R4 gives S9 wave 4.
proposed: Prove the instruction hop in wave 3 against the published contract of S9 served by its fake, and prove the real-owner instruction, result and review in the wave 4 journey RWB-ITG-W4J01-ITG.
